initial_conditions: The Apple Silicon studio has the two original revision 2 patterns open.
actions: Open the original revision 2 project with Juniper and Basin and use Frame all.
Open Save 2D pattern PNG from File. Set 140 by 175 mm, Left U to −430 mm and Bottom V to 275 mm.
Enter 300.012101 pixels per inch and leave the density field using Tab.
Switch from mm through cm, in and px back to mm. Each choice dismisses the menu and the pixel dimensions stay at 1654 by 2067.
Observe the crop outline enclosing Basin and its hole in the 2D pane while the dialog sits on the right. Save the physical crop PNG.
Open the same action from Command search with Command-K, query, Tab and Return. Set the same physical bounds and density.
Switch to px, enter 1680 as width and leave the field using Tab. Save the second PNG.
Compare both files with fresh CLI bytes. Independently decode the exact density, dimensions and original contours.
expected_outcomes: Switching four display units leaves the original crop at 1654 by 2067 pixels. A width edit in pixels increases only width to 1680. Both native files match CLI controls at 11812 pixels per metre. The project retains its bytes.
